summary: Full backend + frontend test of Paxity payment integration. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_paxity_integration.py (7 integration tests via public URL, including live Paxity 401) — all pass. Existing /app/backend/tests/test_paxity_parsing.py (11 unit tests) also passes → 18/18. Frontend Playwright test drove /commande through 3 steps, verified (a) OMSN without OTP triggers French toast 'Code OTP requis — Orange Money Sénégal exige un code OTP avant de valider le paiement.', (b) WAVESN with valid phone reaches Paxity, receives HTTP 401 JSON, and the UI shows a red French banner 'Identifiants Paxity refusés (401). Vérifiez que PAXITY_API_KEY et PAXITY_API_TOKEN...' plus an auto-expanded diagnostic panel (DNS ok, HTTP reachable, http_status 401, auth_test_status 401, latency ~500ms, cause probable message). No blank screen, no JS crash, no HTML/Cloudflare page — response is a clean JSON 401 with the exact expected French detail. App handles Paxity's external credential rejection gracefully as required.
critical_code_review_comments: Route mismatch in original review request: review says navigate to /checkout but App.js defines /commande — no bug (test used /commande). The redirect from /panier to /commande works.
In CartContext, storage key 'sec_cart_v1' persists across sessions — fine but consider clearing on successful payment (already done via clear() presumably).
PAYMENT_METHODS static; no min/max amount limits — Paxity may enforce these server-side. Consider surfacing per-method min amount in /config.

raw_response saved on each transaction — verify no sensitive data (phone, OTP echoes) is persisted. Currently OK because Paxity 401 returns empty body, but should confirm on 2xx flows once creds are valid.
Frontend Checkout.jsx is 713 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting Step1/Step2/Step3 into subcomponents plus the pending/complete screens.
test_credentials: None required. Paxity keys in backend/.env untouched.
seed_data_creation: Frontend test seeded localStorage key sec_cart_v1 with a single Casque product ({id:'p1', price:85000, qty:1, size:'M'}). Backend tests do not seed DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route is /commande (NOT /checkout as review said). Cart requires items in localStorage 'sec_cart_v1' — easier to seed via evaluate() than to click through the product-detail dialog. Use exact=True on get_by_placeholder('Marie'|'Dupont'|'Dakar') because 'Marie' also substring-matches 'marie@exemple.com'. OTP input has required=true at HTML level; strip it via evaluate() to test the client-side toast. Public URL passes 401 through Cloudflare cleanly (only 5xx get rewritten). To rerun backend: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_paxity_integration.py backend/tests/test_paxity_parsing.py -v -n 0`.
rca of the issue: N/A — reported 'payment not working' is expected: Paxity's live API rejects the provided merchant keys with HTTP 401 (external credential/account issue). The app correctly (1) does not crash, (2) parses the empty-body 401 and substitutes a clear French message via _extract_error_message, (3) enforces OTP requirement for OMSN/OMCI client-side and server-side, (4) surfaces a diagnostic panel automatically. Resolution requires new/activated PAXITY_API_KEY + PAXITY_API_TOKEN from Paxity dashboard (possibly an IP whitelisting on the merchant account); no code change needed.
